headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals took down the Detroit Tigers in a thrilling 3-2 victory, with Hao-Yu Lee leading the offense with 2 home runs and 2 RBIs. The Washington Nationals secured a 5-3 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams contributing 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The San Francisco Giants dominated the Los Angeles Angels 9-2, with Robbie Ray earning the win after 6.0 innings of work.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. Cody Bellinger has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the New York Yankees due to a left hamstring strain. Shea Langeliers has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Athletics with a torn meniscus in his right knee. Other notable injuries include Mike Paredes (Minnesota Twins), Josh Jung (Texas Rangers), Spencer Arrighetti (Houston Astros), Juan Soto (New York Mets), Shawn Armstrong (Cleveland Guardians), and Tanner Banks (Philadelphia Phillies).

The Washington Nationals made a notable trade, acquiring Connelly Early from the Boston Red Sox in exchange for 3B Curtis Mead. The Philadelphia Phillies traded for CF Kameron Misner from the Kansas City Royals for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired RHP Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres for future considerations. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin.

top_news.title: **Royals Take Down Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals edged out the Detroit Tigers in a close game, securing a 3-2 win. Hao-Yu Lee led the Royals' offense with a standout performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 5-3 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Foster Griffin earned the win for the Nationals.

top_news.title: **Giants Dominate Angels in 9-2 Rout**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a convincing 9-2 victory over the Los Angeles Angels, with Robbie Ray earning the win after 6.0 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Red Sox 6-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 6-0 victory. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Guardians in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Cleveland Guardians 1-0, securing a narrow victory. Impact performances came from Parker Messick and Drew Rasmussen on the mound, while Chandler Simpson had a notable outing at the plate.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 10-7**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 7-10 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with multiple players contributing to the win. Impact hitters for the Nationals included James Wood, Dylan Crews, CJ Abrams, and Connelly Early.

top_news.title: **Yankees Place Cody Bellinger on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cody Bellinger, the left fielder for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Acquire Curtis Mead in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, trading LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals in exchange for 3B Curtis Mead.
